answer: Beacon spot-checks with a heartbeat stop a sybil flood at the jetty: new identities answer beacon challenges, and only live workers stay. Admission takes a 20-credit bond. As agents wander, the beacon pings 5% each epoch; a missed ping freezes the bond, a failed check burns it. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 20 = 20,000 credits plus 500 daily to weather a gale; one honest agent pays 20 once, refunded after 30 epochs, and keeps its full share.
